scope: Retrospective source and saved-data review for P6 planning; not a new P6 test.

p4.review_scope: Source/XML and saved-result audit; arithmetic over committed CSVs; no simulation or hardware rerun.

provenance_policy.recorded: Numbers copied from saved MuJoCo summaries/CSVs are simulation observations, not hardware measurements.
provenance_policy.code_confirmed: Control structure and passive/fixed-root declarations are established by source/XML inspection.
provenance_policy.derived: CSV phase statistics, sample maxima and differences are reproducible arithmetic over the saved CSV.
provenance_policy.inference: Contact-quality interpretations are explicitly bounded by missing per-contact timeseries.
provenance_policy.single_run_boundary: No single nominal success is classified as robustness evidence.

sampling_and_metric_definitions.peak_rule: Summary force/penetration/actuator maxima are accumulated every mj_step; CSV contains one sample per 0.01 s and can miss narrow peaks. Compare each source at its own rate.
sampling_and_metric_definitions.timestamp_rule: CSV writes data.time after mj_step; the first row is 0.002 s, then 0.012 s, etc. Last CSV sample precedes final simulated time by about 0.008 s.
sampling_and_metric_definitions.contact_count_rule: robot_door_contacts counts contact points whose force norm exceeds 1e-6 N, not number of contacting links or guaranteed grasp constraints.
sampling_and_metric_definitions.force_norm_sum: For robot versus door_single_leaf contacts, sum norm(contact_force[:3]) over contacts in that step. This is neither vector-summed net force nor a six-dimensional wrench.
sampling_and_metric_definitions.contact_pair_max_force_n: Maximum norm of an individual contact encountered for each geom pair over the run; different pair maxima need not be simultaneous.
sampling_and_metric_definitions.penetration: max_robot_door_penetration_m is max(-contact.dist) over robot-door leaf contacts, not a whole-scene clearance guarantee.
sampling_and_metric_definitions.tcp_error_reference: Original nominal task-space path; feedback trim is stored separately and is not incorporated into the tcp_error_m reference.
sampling_and_metric_definitions.summary_absence_rule: Absent monitoring fields are stored as null plus presence=false; they must not be interpreted as observed zero.
sampling_and_metric_definitions.door_state_write_counter: door_state_writes_after_initialization=0 is a hardcoded source declaration; inspection of the loop supports it, but it is not an instrumented write counter.

control_and_scene_evidence.control_description: 100 Hz precomputed world-geometry arm IK path, interpolated while a force-limited position servo drives 500 Hz mj_step. Push feedback adjusts only hold using simulated hinge angle, interpolating the nominal 25-degree and preplanned 29-degree joint paths.
control_and_scene_evidence.force_limit_description: ctrl target plus qfrc_bias/kp enters the same forcelimited actuator. Compensation does not bypass actuator output limits. These limits do not bound contact-force magnitude.
control_and_scene_evidence.phase_transitions: Time based; no contact-loss or unintended-contact event gate. Explicit runtime checks cover nonfinite qpos/MuJoCo warnings, plus window-close stop.
control_and_scene_evidence.bias_description: qfrc_bias includes gravity, Coriolis and centrifugal terms; it is not strictly gravity alone.

door.handle_mass_model: Door leaf inertial mass is a lumped 12 kg uniform-box nominal mass including handles; individual leaf geoms have mass=0, so no separately measured handle mass is added.

floor.physical_interpretation: Static world plane; zero geom mass is not a freely moving massless floor.
floor.damping: No floor damping scalar is specified; hinge damping is unrelated to contact solver softness.
floor.contact_solver_parameters: No floor-specific solref or solimp is set in these P4 scene XML files; MuJoCo defaults apply.
floor.effective_pair_friction_not_audited: These are declared per-geom values. They must not be assumed to equal every robot-floor effective contact pair coefficient without inspecting MuJoCo mixing/defaults and the partner geom.

nominal_scene_parameters.friction_triplet_note: Stored as the exact per-geom MJCF friction values. With condim=3, the contact model uses tangential sliding friction; the presence of torsional/rolling entries alone does not establish active torsional/rolling friction DOFs.

interpretation.angle: Single nominal run reaches 59.96331871179707 degrees; strict 60-degree threshold remains false. Release, retreat and final phase are completed in the record.
interpretation.contact: Only front-handle versus two finger geom-pair types occur in summary; all 2400 pull and 200 hold CSV samples count two nonzero contacts. Per-contact identities are not present in CSV, so sustained per-finger force cannot be reconstructed independently.
interpretation.frame_contact: robot_frame_max_force_n is absent, not an empty dictionary; zero frame contact is not established by this run summary.
interpretation.robustness: No claim of robustness, randomized trials, changed-door conditions or physical-robot performance.

interpretation.angle: Nominal 25-degree hand trajectory produces final passive-door angle 22.098246462530913 degrees.
interpretation.contact: Only the two finger geom-pair types are recorded, but the operation first has fewer than two nonzero contacts at 21.531999999998945 s and approximately 21.521725694840946 degrees. Bilateral finger contact is not continuous; hold samples all contain one contact.
interpretation.baseline_config: Use the config embedded in this summary for reproduction: current config/p4_push.yaml includes feedback and a longer hold, unlike this baseline.

interpretation.angle: Uses simulated hinge-angle feedback only during hold; final trim is 3.01537440281128 degrees and final door angle is 25.076174531441534 degrees.
interpretation.contact: Includes unintended back-handle versus gripper-base contact, whose maximum single-contact force norm is 7.727999372478665 N. It is not a clean two-finger-only success.
interpretation.force_peak: The 9.066882157749472 N contact-norm-sum peak is sampled at 24.611999999997238 s in hold with three nonzero contacts.
interpretation.causal_limit: The exact fraction of door opening attributable to gripper-base contact cannot be recovered because per-contact time-resolved forces/positions are not saved.
interpretation.reference_error: CSV planned_angle_deg and tcp_error_m refer to the original nominal path, even during trim. A roughly 38-42 mm error in late phases includes intentional path correction and is not pure servo tracking error.

interpretation.angle: Documented obstructed 20-degree nominal pull trial ends at 16.82912964899931 degrees.
interpretation.contact: Door-panel versus M1-base contact maximum is 16.408416754513752 N; maximum contact-norm sum is 19.081571137972418 N. Operation later loses all robot-door contact.
interpretation.scene: Run-summary config uses handle height 1.0 m and base [0.82,0.38,0.54266] m; it differs from the successful 0.85 m handle scenes.
interpretation.missing_fields: Old summary lacks multiple current monitoring fields, including frame contact, self contact, warnings and completed-duration flag. Missing values must not be reported as zero or false.

retreat_collision.interpretation: Kinematic sampled-path check only, not dynamic stepping; recorded retreat/final gripper-base versus door-panel penetration.

corrected_pull_candidate_clearance.interpretation: 380 configurations at 10 Hz with no sampled unwanted penetration; not a continuous swept-volume proof.

documentation_caveats.issue: Legacy statement denying measured-angle correction conflicts with the newer push-feedback section.
Legacy next-step-is-P4 statement is superseded by current PROJECT_STATE P6 direction.

definitions.summary_endpoint_vs_csv: summary segment deltas and terminal speeds are recorded at integration-step endpoints. CSV samples are 50 Hz (right committed extraction 10 Hz), offset to t=0.002 s; last sample is before the final integration state. A CSV first-to-last phase displacement is not exactly the summary boundary-to-boundary displacement.
definitions.slip: For each wheel, at loaded floor contacts with normal force >1e-5 N, select the contact point with greatest horizontal velocity norm relative to the stationary ground; decompose that same point velocity along projected axle (lateral) and its horizontal perpendicular (longitudinal). Unloaded wheel values are NaN. Horizontal norm is not purely lateral slip.
definitions.pooled_p95: Slip P95 pools all finite wheel-contact sample values in a phase. Base-speed P95 pools times within the phase. Sampling can miss integration-step peaks.
definitions.support_count: Recorded wheel supports count wheels with at least one contact normal force >1e-5 N; this is not a support-polygon stability margin.
definitions.final_yaw_reconstruction: Final yaw is sum of summary per-phase yaw changes because home yaw=0 and these runs do not cross Euler yaw wrapping.
definitions.right_data_limitation: Right-turn recorded summary used a 50 Hz original run, but repository preserves only 10 Hz 8-column heading extraction. z/velocity/slip/effort window metrics are unavailable from committed right CSV.
definitions.heading_tolerance: 0.12 deg is the controller latch trigger, not a final settled angle bound. status=completed means the timed experiment completed, not that explicit motion acceptance gates passed.

root_height_reference.interpretation: P4 fixes the root at 0.54266 m. P5 starts there but settles near 0.531984 m under gravity and contact, about 10.676 mm lower. P6 should form grasp reachability and world-to-base transforms from measured settled base pose, not assume the P4 fixed-root height remains the free-base height.

sampling.coverage_note: Committed full 50 Hz sampled base pose/velocity, wheel normal/slip, joint position/velocity/effort data. Actuator commands and post-PI yaw_request are not logged.

first_sample_after_target_ramp_with_zero.timing_note: 50 Hz detection of zero yaw_ref after the 5 s ramp, not the exact 500 Hz controller latch instant.

sampling.coverage_note: Committed 10 Hz extraction has only time, phase, x, y, yaw, yaw target, yaw rate, wheel support count. No z, base linear velocity, wheel normal/slip or joint effort time histories; summary maxima and final speed cannot be independently recomputed from this CSV.

inference_limits: No new simulation or disturbance experiment was run.
P5 nominal success does not establish free-base door-force rejection.
Accessory, camera bracket and pedestal additional payload remain omitted per assembly configuration.
Proposed next-stage acceptance thresholds are recommendations and are intentionally not marked as passed by this audit.
